## About
Ferndale Auto Radiator Repair is a radiator shop on historic Woodward Avenue in Ferndale, home of the annual Dream Cruise. We clean, repair and re-core radiators, and we work on heater cores too.
Classic cars are nothing new to us. One reviewer called Mel, the owner, "a true craftsman in his field."
If you just have a cracked inlet tank, you may not need an aftermarket radiator at all. We keep radiator tanks and their parts on hand. Our customers rate us 4.7 from 53 Google reviews.

## Services
- Recoring: We re-core radiators, including classic radiators, so the original can go back in the car.
- Repairing: Repairs on the radiator you have, from classic radiators to current ones.
- Cleaning: Radiator cleaning done in the shop.
- Heater cores (repaired or new): We repair heater cores or supply new ones.
- Radiator tanks and component parts: We keep current radiator tanks and their parts in stock: plastic tanks, gaskets, and internal transmission and oil coolers.
- Cooling capacity: Running hot? We may be able to increase your cooling capacity. Call us to talk it over.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on classic radiators?
A: Yes. We repair or re-core classic radiators.

Q: My radiator has a cracked tank. Do I need a new one?
A: Maybe not. Don't buy an aftermarket radiator when you just have a cracked inlet tank. Call us to discuss your options.

Q: How do I pay?
A: One reviewer noted the shop is cash only. Give us a call if you have questions before you come in.
